back: To repeat or restate something already said (e.g., 'reiterated his concern').
To emphasize the importance of something.
To be a perfect example of something.
To suggest something as a basic fact or principle.
To explain or find the cause of something.
To bring together or include two or more things under one heading.
To cover or include a number of diverse issues.
To label something as belonging to a particular type or class.
To begin an argument or speech with specific introductory remarks.
To map out the text by coming back to a point mentioned later.
To focus on or deal with a specific question or issue.
Ordering points from the smallest/least important to the largest/most important.
To quote or refer to the ideas of several writers as support.
To refer to several themes or ideas indirectly.
